$comment: Illustrations: the brand's own art and layers without words, as scenes at any size. Each subject is a share-image layout (brand/assets/image.json) with its words, badge and lockup taken out, or the octopus art alone. SVG keeps real vector shapes: the reef is the Figma file's own vectors (art/reef.svg, inlined), the wordmark tile, outline band, hatching, guides and the console window are paths, and the octopus is the brand's rendered art (embedded as a picture: it is a 3D render, not a drawing). Rules and sources: brand/illustration.md.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.description: The octopus alone on a theme ground, sitting or hanging (--pose), with its soft shadow (PNG only).

reef.name: Reef scene
reef.description: The reef along the bottom with the sitting octopus in it (the reef layout without words).

window.name: Console window
window.description: The console's inbox in a window between two guides, the octopus hanging over its edge, the reef behind (the product layout without words). --image puts your capture in a browser window instead.

tile.name: Wordmark tile
tile.description: The wordmark tiled in a panel with the sitting octopus on it (the tile layout without words).

pattern.name: Tile pattern
pattern.description: The staggered wordmark tile over the whole frame, inside a line border (the lockup layout's ground).

outline.name: Outline band
outline.description: The band of outlined wordmarks on its rule between hatched strips, the octopus hanging over the rule (the outline layout without words).

hatch.name: Hatched floor
hatch.description: A hatched floor with the octopus hanging over its edge (the hatched layout without words).

sizes: Any image size (brand/assets/image.json sizes) or custom --width and --height; default square, 1080 by 1080.
